cases.explain: "Телеграмма (кого?) Володи" — possession is expressed by the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Юра стал напрашиваться в гости и приглашать Володю к ___
cases.translation: Yura began inviting himself over and inviting Volodya to his own place.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the Dative case; the reflexive pronoun себя takes the Dative form себе here.
The preposition в expressing a destination governs the Accusative, so Москва becomes Москву.

cases.sentence: Он пришел в себя и стал замечать хоть что-то вокруг, только когда оказался возле двери в его ___
cases.translation: He came to his senses only when he found himself by the door of his apartment.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion toward/into governs the Accusative, so квартира becomes квартиру.

cases.sentence: Юра нажал на звонок в подъезде старой ___
cases.translation: Yura rang the bell in the entryway of the old khrushchyovka building.
cases.explain: "Подъезд (чего?) хрущевки" — the noun describing what the entryway belongs to takes the Genitive.

cases.sentence: На пороге стоял высокий, широкоплечий ___ лет тридцати
cases.translation: In the doorway stood a tall, broad-shouldered man of about thirty.
cases.explain: Мужчина is the subject of the verb стоял, so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Фото застряло в проеме между дверью и ___
cases.translation: The photo got stuck in the gap between the door and its frame.
cases.explain: The preposition между ("between") governs the Instrumental case, so косяк becomes косяком.

cases.sentence: Юра ходил в кино на «Маленькую Веру», где впервые увидел постельную сцену на ___
cases.translation: Yura went to see "Little Vera" at the movies, where he saw a bedroom scene on screen for the first time.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location governs the Prepositional case, so экран becomes экране.

reading.ru: Предпоследняя двадцатая глава. Поиски утраченного.
reading.question: What is the title of this chapter?
options: The Search for What Was Lost
reading.correct: The Search for What Was Lost
reading.explain: The chapter is titled "Поиски утраченного" (The Search for What Was Lost).

reading.ru: Телеграмма Володи вызвала у Юрки шок.
reading.question: How did Yurka react to Volodya's telegram?
reading.correct: He was shocked
reading.explain: The text says "Телеграмма Володи вызвала у Юрки шок".

reading.ru: У Володи один с отцом бизнес, а это значит, что он все-таки зависим от отца.
reading.question: What worry does Yurka have about Volodya's independence?
options: That Volodya is financially dependent on his father through their shared business
That Volodya is too young to make decisions
That Volodya has no money at all
reading.correct: That Volodya is financially dependent on his father through their shared business
reading.explain: Yurka fears "У Володи один с отцом бизнес, а это значит, что он все-таки зависим от отца".

reading.ru: Сияющая неподдельным счастьем мама прямо в верхней одежде забежала на кухню, крича «Одобрили! Я уеду, уеду!»
reading.question: What good news does Yura's mother bring, still wearing her coat?
options: Yura was accepted to a school
reading.correct: Their emigration application was approved
reading.explain: She runs in shouting "Одобрили! Я уеду, уеду!" (Approved! I'm leaving!).

reading.ru: Мы уедем в июле.
reading.question: When does Yura tell Volodya his family will leave?
reading.correct: In July
reading.explain: Yura writes to Volodya "Мы уедем в июле" (We will leave in July).

reading.ru: Москва очень ему не понравилась.
reading.question: What was Yura's first impression of Moscow?
options: He fell in love with it instantly
He thought it looked like Kharkiv
reading.correct: He disliked it a lot
reading.explain: The text states plainly "Москва очень ему не понравилась" (he disliked Moscow very much).

reading.ru: Позвонил звонок. Никто не открыл.
reading.question: What happened when Yura first rang the bell at Volodya's apartment?
reading.correct: No one answered
reading.explain: The text says "Позвонил звонок. Никто не открыл" (He rang the bell. No one opened).

reading.ru: Они с полгода как уехали всей семьей», — ответила бабушка, продолжая из щели сверлить Юру взглядом.
reading.question: What does the old neighbor tell Yura about Volodya's family?
options: They moved away as a whole family about half a year ago
reading.correct: They moved away as a whole family about half a year ago
reading.explain: The neighbor says "Они с полгода как уехали всей семьей".

reading.ru: Лев Николаевич с бандитами связался, задолжал им, а отдать не смог.
reading.question: According to the neighbor's gossip, why did Volodya's family flee?
options: Lev Nikolaevich got involved with criminals and couldn't pay his debt
They won the lottery and moved to a bigger house
Lev Nikolaevich got a government job elsewhere
They were being investigated for tax fraud
reading.correct: Lev Nikolaevich got involved with criminals and couldn't pay his debt
reading.explain: The old woman explains "Лев Николаевич с бандитами связался, задолжал им, а отдать не смог".

reading.ru: «Хороший был мальчик, всегда здоровался, сумки носить помогал, но в последнее время стал какой-то дерганый, все время озирался вокруг, здороваться перестал».
reading.question: How does the neighbor describe Volodya's behavior changing recently?
options: He became jumpy, kept looking around, and stopped greeting people
He became more friendly and talkative
He started avoiding the building entirely
reading.correct: He became jumpy, kept looking around, and stopped greeting people
reading.explain: The neighbor recalls Volodya "стал какой-то дерганый, все время озирался вокруг, здороваться перестал".

reading.ru: Брат! У него есть брат, полный тезка!
reading.question: What surprising fact does the neighbor reveal about Volodya's family?
options: Volodya has a brother who is his full namesake
reading.correct: Volodya has a brother who is his full namesake
reading.explain: The neighbor exclaims "Брат! У него есть брат, полный тезка!" (a brother with the exact same name).

reading.ru: Вроде кто-то в Твери есть, — ответила бабушка.
reading.question: Where does the neighbor say some of Volodya's relatives or friends might be?
reading.correct: Tver
reading.explain: The neighbor says "Вроде кто-то в Твери есть" (There's supposedly someone in Tver).

reading.ru: В ящике и правда лежало два письма, но тут же руки опять опустились.
reading.question: What did Yura find when he broke open the Davydovs' mailbox?
options: Two of his own unopened letters
reading.correct: Two of his own unopened letters
reading.explain: Yura finds "два письма" in the mailbox, which turn out to be his own letters that were never picked up.

reading.ru: Из его дома Юра поехал в институт, где не сразу, но узнал, что Володя забрал документы.
reading.question: What does Yura learn at Volodya's institute?
options: That Volodya had withdrawn his documents
That Volodya had transferred to another department
reading.correct: That Volodya had withdrawn his documents
reading.explain: At the institute, Yura learns "что Володя забрал документы" (Volodya had taken back his enrollment documents).

reading.ru: В Твери зашел на почту, купил телефонный справочник и стал обзванивать всех Давыдовых.
reading.question: What method did Yura use to search for Volodya in Tver?
options: Calling every Davydov listed in the phone directory
Asking at the local police station
reading.correct: Calling every Davydov listed in the phone directory
reading.explain: Yura "купил телефонный справочник и стал обзванивать всех Давыдовых" (bought a phone directory and called every Davydov).

reading.ru: «Я ищу Володю Давыдова».
reading.question: What does Yura say when the tall stranger opens the apartment door in Tver?
reading.correct: "I'm looking for Volodya Davydov"
reading.explain: Yura says "Я ищу Володю Давыдова" to the man who answers the door.

reading.ru: Не знаю такого!» — заявил он и захлопнул дверь.
reading.question: How did Vova (the cousin) react to Yura showing him the photograph?
options: He denied knowing Volodya and slammed the door
He asked to keep the photo
reading.correct: He denied knowing Volodya and slammed the door
reading.explain: Vova says "Не знаю такого!" and slams the door shut.

reading.ru: Квартира Коневых муниципальная, а это значило, что они не могли ее продать.
reading.question: Why couldn't the Konev family sell their apartment before emigrating?
reading.correct: It was a municipal (state-owned) apartment
reading.explain: The text explains "Квартира Коневых муниципальная, а это значило, что они не могли ее продать".

reading.ru: Август 1991 года начался отлично. Юра поступил в консерваторию с первого раза, но в середине девятнадцатого числа его ждал удар.
reading.question: How did August 1991 begin for Yura?
options: He was accepted into the conservatory on his first try
He failed his conservatory audition again
reading.correct: He was accepted into the conservatory on his first try
reading.explain: The text says "Юра поступил в консерваторию с первого раза" (Yura got into the conservatory on his first attempt).

reading.ru: «Юра, иди скорее! Юра, там танки в Москве! Горбачева свергли! Господи, что же это делается? Танки!»
reading.question: What shocking news does Yura's mother bring in August 1991?
options: Tanks were in Moscow and Gorbachev had been overthrown
War had broken out with Germany
reading.correct: Tanks were in Moscow and Gorbachev had been overthrown
reading.explain: His mother shouts "там танки в Москве! Горбачева свергли!" (there are tanks in Moscow! Gorbachev has been overthrown!).

reading.ru: Это был параллельный мир, шумный, людный, яркий и свободный.
reading.question: How does Yura describe the gay neighborhood he visits in Berlin?
options: A parallel world, loud, crowded, bright, and free
A neighborhood just like back home
reading.correct: A parallel world, loud, crowded, bright, and free
reading.explain: Yura describes it as "параллельный мир, шумный, людный, яркий и свободный".

reading.ru: Радужный флаг.
reading.question: What symbol does Yura notice reflected on the wet asphalt near the bar?
reading.correct: A rainbow flag
reading.explain: Yura sees "Радужный флаг" (a rainbow flag) reflected in the wet pavement.

reading.ru: акцию под кодовым названием «Операция ЗАГС», которая должна была наделать много шума.
reading.question: What was the codename for the planned protest involving same-sex couples applying for marriage?
reading.correct: Operation ZAGS
reading.explain: The group plans "акцию под кодовым названием «Операция ЗАГС»" (ZAGS being the marriage registry office).

reading.ru: Этот парень к ним приходил, адреса не оставил, а свои письма забрал.
reading.question: What does Yura's old friend report about a mysterious visitor at his old apartment?
options: A man in glasses came, left no address, but took his own letters back
No one had come looking for Yura
The new tenants had moved out
reading.correct: A man in glasses came, left no address, but took his own letters back
reading.explain: The friend writes "Этот парень к ним приходил, адреса не оставил, а свои письма забрал".

reading.ru: Все здесь осталось таким, как тогда, с одной разницей.
reading.question: What does Yura notice when he finally returns to the willow tree years later?
options: Everything remained the same, with one difference
reading.correct: Everything remained the same, with one difference
reading.explain: Standing under the willow again, Yura notes "Все здесь осталось таким, как тогда, с одной разницей".
